description: Kick drum built by modelling an analogue circuit, either an 808-like or a 909-like one

params.text: Pitch the transient starts from, above the pitch the drum falls to
Intensity of the transient at the front of the hit
How long the drum rings before it dies away
Click to sound the kick once
How strongly an accent changes the hit

inputs.text: A trigger here sounds the kick
Modulates the pitch the transient starts from
A voltage here accents the hit as it is triggered; on some drums that means more level, on others a sharper transient with more harmonics
Modulates the intensity of the transient

notes: there is no sequencer or clock here; the drum sounds once for each trigger patched in, or each click on its button
menu: Kick model — chooses 8 (1980) or 9 (1983), an 808-like or a 909-like kick circuit
